scientific_integrity: Analytic theorem with explicit endpoint extremizers; finite computations are supplementary only. Publication priority is qualified, no independence claimed.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to real Hilbert-space surjective linear isometries under a uniform residual error bound and constant Ishikawa parameters. A full-text priority comparison with the motivating 2026 paper was not available; its abstract was inspected and an equivalent classical spectral-filter formulation remains possible.
title: Exact minimax Ishikawa tuning for orthogonal maps with a residual error bound
